# Cognition / Devin — Brand Kit (paid creative)
Version: 0.2 · Sources: https://devin.ai/ · https://devin.ai/desktop (scraped 2026-09-16) · Cognition self-serve pricing (Apr 2026)  
Purpose: Brand Lock for Meta/LinkedIn statics. If a render breaks this kit, **reject and regenerate once**, then fail the concept.

---

## 1. Product truth (say this, not “AI coworker”)

- **Name:** Devin  
- **Category line:** The AI software engineer  
- **Parent:** Cognition  
- **Desktop line:** The home for every agent you run · Manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface  
- **What it is:** An agent that plans and executes real engineering work end-to-end — migrations, refactors, PR review, docs, chores, incident triage — and ships PRs the way the team does.  
- **What it is not:** Chat autocomplete, pair-programming toy, a seat on the org chart, or a generic “AI teammate.”

**Commercial model (must show up in self-serve copy):**
- Free → Pro **$20/mo** → Max **$200/mo** → Teams (usage, **$80/mo** min) → Enterprise (custom, **ACUs / workload**)
- Self-serve: included quota, then dollars for extra work  
- Enterprise: workload-priced, not seat-priced  
- Related: Ask Devin, DeepWiki, Devin Review, Devin Desktop, Devin Automations / API

**Proof language that fits:**
- Named outcomes + time collapse  
- “It merged.” / PR shipped / CI fixed / ticket closed  
- Multi-repo, multi-week, fleet of agents · Sessions · Spaces · Board / List  
- Learns codebase + tribal knowledge  

---

## 2. Voice

| Do | Don’t |
|---|---|
| Short, declarative, engineering-literate | Hype, “AGI,” “replace your team” |
| Concrete work nouns (migration, PR, CI, Linear, Datadog, session) | Vague “productivity 10x” |
| Confident, quiet, spare | Exclamation points, emoji in ads |
| Second person to the engineer (“you review”) | “Synergy,” “empower,” “AI coworker” |
| Workload / quota / finished work | Seats, headcount, “junior engineer” |

**Approved lines (steal / remix):**
- Devin, the AI software engineer  
- The home for every agent you run  
- A team of agents for every engineer  
- Tab, Tab, Ship  
- Never miss a detail  
- Plan, delegate, review, and ship without leaving your editor  
- Pay for work. Not seats. (enterprise — grounded in ACU/workload pricing)

---

## 3. Visual system (Brand Lock) — from live Desktop/home

**Default surface is LIGHT, not charcoal.** Marketing pages use warm off-white; product UI is light IDE chrome; dark (`#000`) is for contrast sections only.

**Palette (exact)**
| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Page / ad ground (default) | `#F7F6F5` | Primary static background |
| Ink | `#191919` | Headlines, body |
| Pure black | `#000000` | Primary CTAs, dark sections, high-contrast frames |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | Cards, buttons on dark, product chrome |
| Accent blue | `#317CFF` | Sparse accent only (tags, links, one underline/dot) — also seen as `#337DF4` |
| Vivid blue (rare) | `#2200FF` | Avoid in ads unless matching a specific product moment |
| Muted label | ~`#6B6B6B` | Secondary lines, mono captions |

**Do not** default ads to neon-on-black “AI dark mode.” Dark ads are allowed only as intentional contrast (e.g. one enterprise frame) with white type — not purple gradients.

**Typography**
- Display / UI: clean grotesque sans (`nbInternationalPro` or nearest: Inter / similar). Regular + medium. Tight tracking on big headlines.  
- Labels / technical: mono (`Geist Mono` / `IBM Plex Mono`) — small, all-caps section tags like `STATS`  
- No ornate editorial serifs on v1 statics  

**Logo / mark**
- Cognition/Devin mark: **three black circles in a tight triangle** (compact geometric). Prefer this mark or the word **Devin** / **DEVIN** — do not invent a new logo.  
- Clearspace ≥ mark height. Never recolor to neon, never put on busy photo.  
- Enterprise customer marks on site are grayscale — match that restraint if using logos (only with permission / public proof).  

**Layout for Meta statics (1080×1080 and 1080×1350)**
- Typographic first: one headline, optional one subline, optional mark or DEVIN wordmark  
- Safe zones: keep critical type out of top/bottom ~10%  
- Plenty of `#F7F6F5` empty space  
- Optional: one small `#317CFF` mono tag (e.g. `PRO` / `ENTERPRISE`)  
- Product UI crops only if from real Desktop chrome and still Brand-Lock clean — never fake illegible IDE soup as the hero  

---

## 4. Forbidden (automatic Brand-Lock fail)

- Neon robots / humanoid “AI” mascots / cartoon agents  
- Fake IDE with illegible lorem code as the hero  
- Purple / magenta “AI startup” gradients · cyberpunk glow  
- Defaulting every ad to charcoal/black when the site default is `#F7F6F5`  
- “Replace engineers,” “fire your team,” “AGI coworker”  
- Seat-count pricing on enterprise ads  
- Unnamed “Fortune 500 saved millions” without a cited public proof  
- Busy stock office photography  
- Ornate editorial / magazine styling that fights the product chrome  

---

## 5. ICP split for creative (3 / 2 default)

**Self-serve (3):** Free / Pro $20 / Max $200 — IC developers  
- Hooks: backlog ticket merged, migrations/tests/chores, stop rationing quota, Desktop as home for agents  
- Proof: the PR / closed ticket — not a logo wall  

**Enterprise (2):** VP Eng / CTO  
- Hooks: named time-collapse proof, workload not seats, fleets / multi-repo  
- Proof: public case-study class claims only when cited in market-truth  

---

## 6. Channel constraints

- Meta Feed: 1080×1350 primary; also 1080×1080  
- LinkedIn: same statics; prefer enterprise concepts  
- Meta primary / headline / description: scannable, no walls of text  

---

## 7. Repo layout beside this file

```
inputs/
  cognition-brand-kit.md    ← this file
  market-truth.md
  winners/                  ← optional real ads or Desktop UI crops
```

Brand refs (internal): `brand-refs/` screenshots from Desktop + home — use as visual truth for Astra, not as ad creatives themselves.

</brand-kit>

## 2. Buyers & workflows with strongest evidence

### A. Self-serve / power developers (Pro/Max) — strong category language

**Workflow (OBS-backed category):** Cloud / background / async agent = **ticket → PR**, not autocomplete.  
- **OBS:** AI/TLDR — cloud agent “goes off to a fresh remote machine… comes back later with a finished pull request”; “You don’t babysit it. You delegate, walk away, and check the result.” (access 2026-09-15)  
- **OBS:** BuildMVPFast — “You’re a dispatcher”; output = “a branch and a PR, not a suggestion in your editor.”  
- **OBS (X, Trylions):** cloud agent = async GitHub-native coding worker, distinct from IDE agent mode.  
- **OBS (Reddit r/vibecoding):** “Cursor is great when I want tight feedback… Devin is better for handing off well-defined work… bigger issue is context, not model quality.”

**INT for copy:** Lead with category nouns (*async PR*, *ticket → tested PR*, *dispatcher*) before brand lore.

### B. Engineering / platform leads — strong on backlog parallelism + review bottleneck

**Workflows:**  
- Backlog as **parallelism** (migrations, flaky tests, dependency bumps, coverage gaps) — one playbook / many repos.  
- Trust = **review capacity**, not generation volume (*lines that survive review*; *morning batch review*; *finished diff to check*).  
- **OBS (Reddit r/windsurf):** fork is review loop — “Devin hands you a finished diff to check, Claude Code lets you watch and interrupt… I pick by how verifiable the task is.”

### C. Enterprise (VP Eng / CIO / platform / security / procurement) — medium evidence, thin independent Devin diaries

**Workflows (category + vendor-adjacent):** governed fleets; permission controls / isolated sandbox / audit trail / bounded autonomy; measurable modernization — **without invented ROI**.  
- **OBS (X):** permission gates, session replay, “real data instead of demos,” “No lock-in.”  
- **Limitation:** Independent last-90-day Devin customer diaries scarce vs category “async agent” content; enterprise logos in company-context = **CLAIM / re-verify**, not Meta static proof in Marley sample.

### Secondary (weaker core ICP)

Designers / PMs / founders shipping with agents — Replit often wins blank-page. **Do not** lead Meta statics with idea-to-app / “no coding” (wrong ICP for Devin core).

Hard rules:
- No pricing, no quota or rationing claims, no ACU figures.
- No governance guarantees: do not say sessions are always recorded, that secrets always halt a run, or name certifications.
- No invented customer outcomes, savings, percentages, latencies or merge rates. No customer logos.
- Never "replaces engineers". The human owns the merge.
- Quotes must exist verbatim in market-truth.md.
- Voice: short, declarative, engineering-literate. Concrete work nouns. No emoji, no exclamation points.

angles.title: Hand off the ticket. Review the PR.
angles.insight: Developers will delegate bounded, well-scoped work if the result comes back as an inspectable diff.
angles.hypothesis: We believe framing Devin as delegation of a well-scoped ticket, with the developer keeping the merge, will lower cost per activated signup versus command-center and tooling-comparison framing.
